entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Alex. I have your order pulled up. So I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Look, it's just not for me. I find it really **hard to use**. The whole interface is **confusing** and I honestly **expected more** for the price. I even read the **user manual** and it didn't help. Can I return it, yes or no?
Yes, you can. I understand completely. Let me just confirm the delivery date... Okay, I see it was delivered 14 days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return policy.
Good. So what do I do?

I've just processed the return authorization for you. You will receive an email in the next few minutes with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thanks for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
